This lesson teaches Sarufi 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi kutendewa kutendeka kutendana for Grade 5 KISWAHILI.

1. Explain the main ideas in Sarufi 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi kutendewa kutendeka kutendana

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING

Example 1: Describe Sarufi 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi kutendewa kutendeka kutendana using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi kutendewa kutendeka kutendana with school or home examples.

3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
